newsitem.title: UK: Chevron says Nigeria oil output running as normal.
newsitem.headline: Chevron says Nigeria oil output running as normal.

text.p: U.S.-based Chevron Corp's Nigerian Escravos oil output was running as normal on Thursday, a company official in Lagos said.
"We lost about four or five thousand barrels for a couple of days last weekend but since Monday we've been at full production," the official said.
"We've been able to continue full production," he added.

Chevron said on Tuesday that two of its oil installations in the western region of the Niger delta were briefly picketed by villagers from communities feuding with a local government over relocation of their headquarters.
Chevron pumps a total of some 360,000 barrels a day (bpd) into the Escravos stream, most of which is exported.
